* Alchemy: 47
* Astrology: 32
* Falconry: 37
* Logic: 89
* Music: 56
* Swordsmanship: 35
* Tarot: 46
* Xylomancy: 34

What was their mean score?

| A | 9 | 4 |
| B | 11 | 8 |
